description: This source file implements trust store management for Windows, including certificate store initialization, certificate trust evaluation, and issuer retrieval, specifically for the Chromium project.

classes.name: TrustStoreWin::CertStores
classes.description: Encapsulates multiple Windows certificate stores used for trust evaluation, including root, intermediate, trusted people, disallowed, and a combined store.

classes.name: TrustStoreWin::Impl
classes.description: Implements the core logic for managing certificate stores, retrieving issuers, and determining trust status for certificates.

methods.name: TrustStoreWin::CertStores::CreateInMemoryStoresForTesting
methods.description: Creates in-memory certificate stores for testing purposes.

methods.name: TrustStoreWin::CertStores::CreateNullStoresForTesting
methods.description: Creates null (empty) certificate stores for testing.

methods.name: TrustStoreWin::CertStores::CreateWithCollections
methods.description: Creates certificate stores backed by Windows certificate collections.

methods.name: TrustStoreWin::CertStores::InitializeAllCertsStore
methods.description: Initializes the combined 'all' certificate store with intermediate and root stores.

methods.name: TrustStoreWin::TrustStoreWin
methods.description: Constructor for TrustStoreWin, initializes the trust store with certificate collections.

methods.name: TrustStoreWin::InitializeStores
methods.description: Ensures the trust store is initialized.

methods.name: TrustStoreWin::MaybeInitializeAndGetImpl
methods.description: Lazy-initializes the implementation object managing trust store logic.

methods.name: TrustStoreWin::CreateForTesting
methods.description: Creates a TrustStoreWin instance with custom certificate stores for testing.

methods.name: TrustStoreWin::GetTrust
methods.description: Determines the trust level of a given certificate based on Windows certificate stores.

methods.name: TrustStoreWin::SyncGetIssuersOf
methods.description: Retrieves issuer certificates for a given certificate from the trust stores.
